comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
For those curious...

Male characters get 16 possible styles, 13 of which are the "start-game" default. I recognize #14 as belonging to Frederik (Dutch storyline NPC), but #15 and #16 are seemingly unique.

Female characters get 17 possible styles (not sure how many are "start-game" default options). #13 belongs to Liza (English storyline NPC), and the rest are seemingly unique.

A comp-mate bought some of these tools for under 100mil each, but the price will always vary from seller to seller. Good hunting to those who want them.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
And now, a long overdue visual aid of both male and female hairstyles: eririndol.blog.fc2.com/blog-category-6.html

Please note, this particular item only allows you to access hairstyles from 01-16 (men) or 01-17 (women). The rest of the hairstyles depicted on that reference page come from different items.

One example is the Aphrodite's Mirror which I believe grants access to all the above hairstyles, plus a few not shown in the reference screenshots. I hope this helps; cheers, and great online voyaging to you.
